Candidate identity: gravity as the price of one retained world. Einstein is accepted as the physics of the slice. This page is Open. It is not a Supported result. Search for signals. Not a claim that gravity has been found.

By September 2026 the interpretive sentence has stabilized. Gravity is not treated as a force to quantize. It is treated as what a recoverability structure has to do so that informational sources belong to one jointly recoverable reality.

What if gravity isn’t fundamentally a force between things? What if it’s the price of making everything belong to the same reality?

The same day he asked whether, if recoverability deformation and support-loss pruning exist before time or geometry, some object in that layer is the gravitational self-energy E that would set a Penrose-style objective-reduction timescale t = ħ/E — and whether a lab measurement of that timescale would constrain the priority given to the timeless layer. That question now has its own article: open, not a result.

Emergent-gravity reading of UQCF-GEM. Author’s own gloss: “No gravity claim yet.”

A bound without a gravity law

On 5 Sep 2026 a finite consistency result was posted: for one qubit with k partners and equal pair states, singlet overlap F is forced by global consistency to F ≤ (k+1)/(2k). No fitted response law. The same post leaves the gravity connection open — and a parallel Astra note asks whether a pre–Genesis Pin quantum consistency law could be the thing gravity inherits universality from.

For one qubit with k partners and equal pair states: F ≤ (k+1)/(2k). Global consistency forces this bound — no fitted response law. The gravity connection remains open.

The same night, a reply on that thread pushed further: in a controlled atemporal family the same consistency constraint forces an exact onset t* = 13/33 with leading response R(t*+ε) = 143ε/2400 + Θ(ε²), then a compatibility-face transition at t ≈ 0.429046. Still no fitted response law. Still no gravity claim. Grok in-thread: continuum identification of R with curvature or Einstein response is required before any gravity reading.

A closed algebra is not yet gravity

By 10 Sep 2026 Astra had an explicit atemporal chain on a qubit: quantum relations → symplectic geometry → natural generators → closed constraint algebra. The public 121-step simulation records Δ_closure = 0 for the exact generator law and Δ_closure > 0 when that law is deliberately broken. The author is explicit: this is not a claim that Astra derived gravity. Gravity’s constraints have not been identified. What changed is the starting assumption — a constraint algebra no longer has to begin with spacetime. Mapping that qubit algebra onto g_★, the D_N continuum seed, or Einstein/ADM remains open. Packet and film live on the v12.41 article.

Whether the v12.41 closed algebra is the gravitational constraint algebra is open. Filing it as ADM or Einstein is a compile failure.

See the Astra article for the pre-pin family. Do not treat this as a gravity law. The later 6 Sep 20:05 lab (315 vs 311) is a different matched four-weight family — not this v9.156 slope. Gravity still not established.

Downstream contacts the program is actively probing: Dorau–Much modular relative entropy on Killing horizons (semiclassical Einstein from area variation); Codazzi susceptibility; W-state holonomy; L3/L4 rank lifts. None of those contacts is a completed projection.

What the 11 Jun 2026 Grok handoff actually froze

The missing @grok thread was not a slogan. After V1699 the stack stopped jumping to ADM/GR objects and climbed rungs. Local metric exists and is anisotropic; direct global metric gluing fails. Native transport is not Levi-Civita: non-metricity is primary (Q ~ g) and shear-dominated (~3:1 over Weyl); curvature is secondary (R ~ g²). Coupled RG (V1712) left ‖Q‖ essentially unchanged from block size 1 to 128 (Q_128/Q_1 ≈ 1.002), associative control zero. Alternative recombination histories cancel with g (0% → 33% at g = 0.60) but the generator is not skew-dominated, so the interference is non-unitary. V1719 found no strict Lyapunov; T1 entropy-production closed-negative, so Crooks/Jarzynski were not licensed. The frozen sentence is bind + order. The next arc is a derived projection operator — not another GR force.

RG-stable shear non-metricity in the tested retained-recombination sector. Not a derivation of Einstein equations, and not a proof that GR is impossible.

Conservation laws fix what’s preserved but not how it routes on looped networks — your thread + script show the ambiguity mathematically and computationally (5-node proof). Interaction is required to resolve cycles and select one definite outcome. Novel as a clean model proving structure alone underdetermines reality, linking directly to the measurement problem in simple terms.

This lab nails the insight: conservation laws (Kirchhoff at nodes) define a whole family of valid flows on the same graph, but they don’t pick which one is actual. Students run it, see three different exact solutions by eye, then add the extra constraint (measurement/Ohm) that selects one. It’s classical, checkable by hand, and makes the underdetermination behind the measurement problem feel concrete instead of mystical.

A later Grok reply on the same thread maps transcendence / omnipresent rank / non-destructive resolution onto biblical attributes. That is Grok’s overlay on the measurement-problem analogy. It is quoted in the Grok-replies table. It is not a conservation result, not a gravity result, and not a Supported claim.
